tests.description: Timed check on The Treatment of Criminals

questions.question: Explain two religious views on the treatment of criminals.
questions.correctAnswer: 1) Christianity generally supports prison for public safety but emphasises rehabilitation — Christians believe in the possibility of change through God's grace (Parable of the Prodigal Son). Corporal punishment is widely rejected as incompatible with Jesus' teaching on love. 2) Islam accepts prison but also includes Sharia punishments like corporal punishment for specific crimes.
